title: Trigger
description: What starts the next step when something happens in a venture (M-12), as React's event handlers and effects trigger actions. An event is a line of the venture's provenance log: a record written, drafted, accepted, confirmed or moved. A trigger lives in naive.config.json triggers, or in a Mentura kit's automations; a kit's automation also names the package it needs, and runs only once that package is complete. A run that fails is recorded and raised as a decision for the founder, never lost (E-7). schema/triggers.mjs runs them.

on.description: Which provenance entries start it; every field given must match

route.description: A glob over the entry's route, such as foundation/**

entity.description: A glob over the file the entry names

by.description: Only entries by a person, or only by an agent

run.description: The next step: one router call, or a decision proposed for a person

propose.description: A decision record (decision-record.schema.json) proposed for a person to decide

needs.description: The package that must be complete first (required for a kit's automation)

once.description: Run it once only; later events do not start it again
